name: io.github.chrischall/zillow-mcp
description: Zillow real-estate for Claude — search, property details, Zestimates, saved searches & homes

environmentVariables.name: ZILLOW_COMMUNITIES_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path to a JSON file containing a string array that overrides the default community vocabulary used for feature extraction.

environmentVariables.name: ZILLOW_LOCALITY_ALIASES_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path to a JSON file of [a, b] locality pairs (each registered both ways) that overrides the default locality aliases used by the address resolver.

environmentVariables.name: ZILLOW_DEBUG
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 for verbose fetchproxy transport logging to stderr.

environmentVariables.name: FETCHPROXY_WS_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Bind interface for the fetchproxy concentrator, a literal IP only (default 127.0.0.1). Keep on loopback; it exists for hosted deployments that run each MCP in its own network namespace.

environmentVariables.name: FETCHPROXY_IDENTITY_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path where the fetchproxy long-term identity keypair is stored (default ~/.fetchproxy/identity/).
